estimates.assumptions: 1 tablespoon Shaoxing wine weighs ~14g (standard liquid density for wine/sauce).
1/2 tsp ground pepper weighs ~1g (standard density for ground spices).
1/2 tsp kosher salt weighs ~3g (standard density for kosher salt).
1 spring onion (scallion) is estimated at 15g edible portion (typical whole trimmed weight).
20 medium shrimp (peeled, deveined, raw) total ~100g edible portion (5g each is realistic for small-medium shrimp).
2 cups uncooked jasmine rice weighs ~360g (standard 180g per cup dry rice).
